response.courseDescription: 498 Professional Work Experience/Internship May be repeated for credit; cumulative maximum 4 hours. Undergraduate professional experience or internship course designed to complement the academic program, provide practical learning, and facilitate the transition to industry; one credit per 45 hours of approved experience. S, F grading.
response.coursePrerequisites: By department permission; VIT ENOL 113; VIT ENOL 280.
